text:
Sam: Heads up — noticed a tiny snippet in the compact-runbook KB that 404s when you click the curl example. The anchor looks like /runtime/curl#post-auth. Anyone owns compact-runbook?

Maya: @Sam I can take a look later today. Which example? can you paste the line?

Sam: Here's the curl block: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-small","prompt":"hi"}'
``` clicking the link in the snippet goes to /docs/runtime/post-auth which 404s.

Dev-bot: link-scan found 404 for /docs/runtime/post-auth in page compact-runbook.md (auto-alert)

Maya: ok will swap to canonical /docs/runtime/auth#post-auth and open PR. also propose removing the trailing shortlink and use absolute path.

Amit: FYI when you open the PR add me for a quick lint pass. small change — no need for full QA.

Maya: created PR #2486 — shortlink swap + lint. pinging @Amit for review.

Amit: reviewing now. small nits inline.

Maya: pushed fix for nits. CI green.

Rosa: can we batch similar snippet swaps? saw 3 pages with the same shortlink pattern (compact-runbook, onboarding/quickstart, runtime-guide). volunteer to run a grep if helpful.

Sam: yes please — if we can sweep and create a single PR per page it's cleaner. also can we add ownership to frontmatter? who should be doc owner for compact-runbook?

Rosa: suggest @dev-ex since it's onboarding material. I'll add dev-ex@redwood as frontmatter owner for the doc and note in PR.

Dev-ex: thanks @Rosa — can you CC me on the PR? will add quick note to the docs sprint board and pin the owner.

Maya: PR merged. deployed to staging.

Sam: verified link in staging, :thumbsup:

Dev-bot: deploy to staging succeeded — build 2026.03.19-178

Amit: small follow-up — can we add a rule to the docs-contrib checklist to prefer absolute paths for curl/code examples and avoid shortlinks? I'll draft a one-liner for the guide.

Sam: sounds good. if nobody objects I'll schedule a 15m async sync to capture the sweep plan tomorrow 10:00 PT. low-friction — just confirmation and who picks pages.

Rosa: works for me.

Dev-ex: added event 10:00-10:15 PT to docs channel calendar.

Sam: closing loop — thanks all for quick turnaround.
